content_fields.title: Use an account and identity management system
content_fields.description: Source accounts and identities for this service from a central account and identity management system.
content_fields.guidance: Identity lifecycle should be owned centrally: provisioning, role assignment, recertification and deprovisioning driven by the identity system rather than by application-local records.
content_fields.found: A local users table is the sole identity store, seeded at startup and extended through self-registration.
content_fields.missing: A central identity platform, a provisioning connector and an authoritative source for role assignment.
content_fields.conclusion: Adopting central identity management is a platform decision requiring systems outside this repository.
content_fields.action: The identity and access management team should own selection and rollout of the account and identity management system.
